description: Rename geotagged photos in a folder to a capture-time + place name derived from EXIF/GPS (offline, in place).

folder.description: Absolute path to the directory whose geotagged photos are renamed in place.

dryRun.description: When true, preview the renames without changing any files. Omit (or false) to perform the real rename.

format.description: Output format. Defaults to json when omitted.
